title: Resolve diagnostic E-104
summary: Diagnose version 2.0 error E-104, which indicates that the configured trust certificate has expired or is not yet valid.

sections.title: Meaning
paragraphs: In version 2.0, E-104 is raised when certificate validity does not include the controller's current UTC time. This differs from the version 1.5 definition.

warning.condition: Certificate checking is disabled to bypass E-104.
warning.consequence: Clients can no longer verify the controller endpoint.
warning.avoidance: Correct time synchronization or replace the certificate; do not disable verification.

sections.title: Resolution
paragraphs: Compare the controller clock with the certificate's validity window before replacing credentials.
steps: Record the current UTC time and E-104 event timestamp.
Verify NTP reachability and time-zone display settings.
Inspect the certificate not-before and not-after dates.
Install a valid replacement certificate if the clock is correct.
Reconnect one test client and confirm that E-104 clears.
